Ava Markham (born December 29, 1999) is an American tennis player. Raised in Demarest, New Jersey , Markham attended Northern Valley Regional High School at Demarest . [ 1 ] She has a career-high doubles ranking by the WTA of 301, achieved June 2024. [ 2 ] Markham won her biggest title to date at the 2022 The Women's Hospital Classic , where she partnered Kolie Allen to win the doubles draw.
